name: ghd-autoscore
description: 国旗护卫队单机版积分管理与统计工具
author: 国旗护卫队

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "vite" "node scripts/build-electron.cjs --watch" "wait-on tcp:5173 file:dist-electron/main.js && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron .
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run build:electron && electron-builder
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run build:electron && node scripts/e2e-smoke.cjs dev && node scripts/e2e-scenarios.cjs dev
scripts.test:e2e:packaged: node scripts/e2e-smoke.cjs packaged && node scripts/e2e-scenarios.cjs packaged
scripts.test: npm run test:services && npm run test:project && npm run test:stress && npm run test:render
